rows.note: Use 合約 as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a work agreement, a legally binding agreement, or the contract document itself.

example.english: I signed a two-year contract with the company.
example.traditional: 我同間公司簽咗兩年合約。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 gaan1 gung1 si1 cim1 zo2 loeng5 nin4 hap6 joek3

rows.note: Use 染 as the all-purpose spoken choice when someone picks up an illness or bad habit.

example.english: I can contract the flu easily at work.
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 gung1 hou2 jung4 ji6 jim5 lau4 gam2

rows.note: Use 縮 for something physically drawing together, becoming shorter, or becoming narrower.

example.english: This shirt will contract after washing.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 sai2 jyun4 wui5 suk1 seoi2

rows.note: Use 簽約 when the parties formally make an agreement by signing a contract.

example.english: We will contract with a new supplier next month.
example.traditional: 我哋下個月同新供應商簽約。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 tung4 san1 gung1 jing3 soeng1 cim1 joek3

rows.note: Use 外判 when a company hires an outside provider to carry out a service or job.

example.english: The company will contract out the cleaning to a professional team.
example.traditional: 間公司將清潔工作外判畀專業團隊。
example.jyutping: gaan1 gung1 si1 zoeng1 cing1 git3 gung1 zok3 ngoi6 pun3 bei2 zyun1 jip6 tyun4 deoi6
